source: Planyr's bundled nationwide county polygons (public/geo/county-polygons.json, Census TIGER-derived), Michigan's 83 counties; scripts/gen-mi-county-fixture.mjs picks, per county, an interior centre, 4 more interior points spread across it (farthest-point picks) and 4 points in the band just inside its county line, all resolved by the bundled polygons to that county. gaps = the counties with no usable open parcel service wired (NEW-1, 2026-10-20) and the re-searched reason for each.

Not worked around. Re-searched 2026-10-19/20: ArcGIS Online item search by county name, the county's and its regional bodies' orgs (orgid-wide parcel/tax/property search, sub-domain guesses), the State DTMB county tax-parcel directory, the county's landing page (read through the relay) and web search.

Calhoun.reason: The county's parcel viewer is FetchGIS (Amalgam LLC, app.fetchgis.com/?currentMap=…). Its ArcGIS Server (app.fetchgis.com/geoservices/fgis/<x>Parcels/FeatureServer/0, read from the viewer's own main.js) answers a plain non-browser request with an HTTP 520 connection reset through the relay (and the county's own ArcGIS Server, gis.calhouncountymi.gov, answers 401 'Access is denied due to invalid credentials') although the viewer page itself loads; using it would mean replaying the viewer's browser identity, which Planyr does not do (same rule as the Integrity-GIS token sites in Missouri). A data agreement with Amalgam LLC would unlock about 25 Michigan counties at once — owner decision.
